ModMetaData.name: Living Cities
ModMetaData.author: SedesNoctis
ModMetaData.description:
Round cities for factions that have one: rings of walls, nests and halls, galleries, heavy outer gates and sky wells. Factions get them through a CityDef; everyone else keeps vanilla bases.
Stage 1: the generator. Living city life (residents' schedules, renting, duties, law) comes later.
